issues: Says capital is 'OpVaR minus EL' when expected_loss_covered is true, omitting the max(·,0) floor shown in the formula.
Phrasing 'at least as small as the full Art. 201 charge' is awkward; the record says the true Art. 201 SCR is at least as large as the result.
Does not mention that omega defaults to diag(P τΣ Pᵀ) when omitted.
Does not mention that the redress ratio is scaled by 500 before being capped at 50.
Says 'tiered multiplier' but doesn't state the 3x/5x tiers or 7%/20% thresholds
Does not mention that the qmc and greeks options cannot be used together.
Says the function 'fits' a GARCH(1,1) model, but the record only filters with user-supplied or default alpha/beta and does not estimate parameters.

The record flags the default magnitudes as a limitation because BCBS d578 recalibrated them in 2024 (effective 2026). The answer reads as if the defaults already reflect d578, which inverts that caveat.
It promises six shock curves but describes only four (parallel up/down, steepener, flattener); the short-rate up/down shocks are not mentioned.
It says the short/long weights vary by tenor but omits the e^{-t/4} decay that defines how.
Says the test catches departures in either direction without noting the simplified one-sided form at x=0 or x=n.
Doesn't contrast with sibling loss_distribution_approach_lda, which also runs the full LDA pipeline.
Grouping risk_aversion with tau and omega as a control on view-versus-prior weighting is loose: λ scales the equilibrium returns Π and the final weights, not the relative confidence.
'component-by-component view' slightly overstates the output; the record only describes summing add-ons into a total and a ratio
Does not state the 72.5% floor factor value, which the record gives.
The last bullet sits under 'use this function when' but describes a need that the sibling unexpected_loss_ul_computation meets, not this function.
That framing implies EL gives the loss spread around the average, which the record does not support.
